title: India and Netherlands Elevate Ties to Strategic Partnership
detail: India and the Netherlands formally elevated their bilateral relations to a strategic partnership, announced by Prime Minister Narendra Modi during his visit to the Netherlands as part of a five-nation European tour. The upgrade covers cooperation in energy, trade, and broader diplomatic relations, marking a significant deepening of ties between the two nations.

PM Modi's Netherlands visit as part of five-nation European tour covering energy, trade, and diplomacy
